# Mini Golf Scorecard project instructions

## Scope

Mini Golf Scorecard is a local-first scorecard with guest play and an optional
ACM Account identity connection under development. Keep game data in the
browser and preserve the responsive desktop and mobile experience.

## Boundaries

- Keep score data local to the browser. The existing optional ACM Account
  connection establishes identity only; it does not sync or back up scores.
  Do not expand authentication or add server-side score persistence without an
  explicit product decision.

## Commands

- Run locally with `npm run dev`.
- Verify changes with `npm run lint` and `npm test`.

## Verification

- Check score entry, player ordering, completion indicators, sharing actions and
  responsive layouts after interface changes.

## Releases

After a requested Mini Golf Scorecard change passes its validation checks, automatically commit, tag, push, and deploy it to the live site. Do not ask for separate publication approval unless the user explicitly requests local-only work, asks not to publish, or the change cannot be safely validated. Preserve the previous validated commit as the rollback point, verify the hosted deployment independently, and stop to report the failure if deployment does not succeed.

# Changelog

## Unreleased

### Added

- Keyboard-accessible player movement and column resizing, with retained focus
  and announced player positions.

### Fixed

- Applied one positive whole-number score rule to entry, stepping, totals,
  statistics and saved games; invalid edits retain the previous score.
- Kept leaderboard cards ranked by score rather than presenting manual drag
  controls that cannot change their ranking.

### Security

- Protected CSV text cells from spreadsheet formula interpretation while
  preserving the original stored and HTML-exported values.

- Completed the final code-quality pass with strict type checking, focused browser adapters and cleaned-up interaction and styling boundaries.

### Fixed

- Restored lime winner and purple tie highlighting for completed score rows, including matching score input accents.

- Consolidated CSV, HTML and image export preparation under shared contracts and removed unused account and database scaffolding.

### Fixed

- Centred hole number circles in the optimised hole column while keeping completion ticks halfway to the first player column.

## 0.1.19 — 2026-08-27

### Fixed

- Optimised the hole column on desktop and mobile, with completion ticks centred between each hole number and the first player column.

## 0.1.14 — 2026-08-23

## 0.1.6 — 2026-08-21

### Changed

- Centred score value boxes within their player columns on smaller screens.

## 0.1.5 — 2026-08-21

### Changed

- Slightly increased the character spacing on score values for readability.

## 0.1.4 — 2026-08-21

### Changed

- Widened the desktop score spinner so its controls have a squarer shape.
- Added a slight amount of character spacing to score values for readability.

## 0.1.3 — 2026-08-21

- Made the desktop score spinner the same height as its value box.

### Added

- Added desktop score controls immediately to the right of each value box.

### Changed

- Removed the browser's native number spinner from score fields.

### Fixed

### Added

- Linked the Buy Me a Coffee logo to Andrew Moss's support page.

### Added

- First public release.
- Added a LinkedIn link to the footer.

# Mini Golf Scorecard

[Open Mini Golf Scorecard](https://mini-golf-scorecard.andrewcharlesmoss.chatgpt.site/)

Mini Golf Scorecard is a simple, mobile-friendly web app for keeping score during a round of mini golf. Add players, enter scores hole by hole, and follow the live leaderboard as the game unfolds.

## Features

- Set a course length of up to 18 holes and add up to eight players.
- Rename and reorder players with pointer or keyboard controls, resize their
  columns, and enter scores on desktop or mobile.
- Use positive whole-number scores, or leave unplayed holes blank.
- See per-hole totals, player totals, averages, standard deviation, and the current leader.
- Keep scores on the device, so a refresh does not lose an in-progress game.
- Start a new game or reset scores when the round is over.
- Share results by downloading an Excel-compatible file, copying a screenshot, or copying email-ready HTML.

## Run locally

Requires Node.js 22.13 or later.

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Verify changes

```sh
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm test
```

`npm test` builds the app and verifies the rendered homepage.

## Usage

Guest play remains available. The current source also contains an optional ACM
Account identity connection under development; signing in does not sync, back
up or move scores to an account. Game data stays in browser-local storage. This
local source description is not verification of the hosted sign-in flow.

If browser storage is unavailable or full, score entry still works and a warning
asks you to download the round before closing the page. An unreadable saved
game is preserved rather than overwritten by the fallback round.

Move buttons keep focus with the player and announce the new position. Focus a
column resize handle and use Left/Right to change its width by 10 pixels, or
Home to return to the existing minimum width. The leaderboard remains ranked
by scores rather than manually ordered. CSV exports protect text cells from
spreadsheet formula interpretation without changing stored names or scores.

The public site is hosted at [mini-golf-scorecard.andrewcharlesmoss.chatgpt.site](https://mini-golf-scorecard.andrewcharlesmoss.chatgpt.site/).

## Documentation

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for notable user-facing updates.

## Versioning

Mini Golf Scorecard uses semantic versioning. Patch releases fix bugs or make small refinements, minor releases add user-facing features, and `1.0.0` will mark the first stable release. Each published version is recorded in the changelog and tagged in Git.
